question: As of November 2022, who among the following is the Governor of Maharashtra, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagat Singh Koshyari.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of **November 2022**, the **Governor of Maharashtra**, India is **Bhagat Singh Koshyari.**
 
• From **2019 to 2023**, he was Maharashtra's **22nd governor.**
 
• Veteran of the RSS, Koshyari was the first state president of the** BJP for Uttarakhand **and national vice president. 
 
• From **2001 to 2002,** he was also **Uttarakhand's second chief minister.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On **February 18, 2023, Shri Ramesh Bais** took the oath of office as **Maharashtra's governor.**
 
• **Arif Mohammed Khan** is the current **Governor of Kerala**, India.
 
• **Ganesh Lal Mathur **was the Governor of **Rajasthan**, India from **2004 to 2007.**
 
 
• Indian politician **Kalraj Mishra** is the current governor of **Rajasthan. **
